A motion to formally initiate that ordinance was scheduled for a Community Services Cluster Agenda Review on 2026-09-23, with a Board of Supervisors hearing expected around 2026-10-06.
field_changes.after: Reported interim administrative prohibition on large-scale AI data centers in unincorporated county areas pending comprehensive zoning amendments. The exact September 17 memorandum and its operative endpoint remain unverified. On October 6, 2026, the Board referred the proposed zoning-amendment motion (26-6069) back to Supervisor Solis’s office; that action did not adopt the proposed permanent prohibition.

The Daily News reported a September 23 Community Services Cluster Agenda Review and described roughly 1 million residents in unincorporated areas; prior research expected Board consideration around October 6. It described smaller enterprise, accessory and sole-source facilities as excluded from the proposed ordinance; whether those exceptions apply to the memorandum has not been established.
